Theme 017 · Typography & graphic systems

Variable-Font Data Morph

A field of numerals where type weight is the data: every glyph's weight encodes how far its metric has drifted from normal. Pulse's scan is a weight wave rolling across the grid; everything thins back out except one number that stays heavy, turns coral and swells into the hero.

4 · CTA0:36–0:45

Each tagline line morphs its weight as a ramp, left → right then right → left. The ramps sweep once per bar, freeze on the downbeat, and "Start free" snaps from 200 to 800 on the final hit.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Type grid — 12 columns of two-digit numerals in Manrope variable (200–800), tabular figures.
  • Weight wave — a moving front that drives font-weight by distance: the visual form of the scan.
  • Anomaly glyph — the one numeral that stays at 800, in coral, with a thin halo ring.
  • Axis legend — "wght = deviation" with sample glyphs from 200 to 800, so the encoding is explicit.
  • Hero number — the anomaly promoted to 170 px Manrope 800 with a mono caption stack.
  • Weight-ramp headline — tagline letters graded thin → heavy as a frozen wave.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Wave sweep — wght 200 → 800 → 200 by distance from a moving front, 60 ms stagger per column, sine.inOut; the front crosses the grid in one bar at 120 BPM (2 s).
  • Tension hold — anomalies stay heavy and pulse 800 ↔ 700 on every beat (500 ms), everything else relaxes to 200.
  • Hero morph — the anomaly scales 1 → 3.6 while its weight holds at 800 (expo.out, 800 ms), landing on the downbeat.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

Weight is a pre-attentive signal: the eye finds the heavy glyph before it reads a single number, which is exactly how an anomaly should feel. The system is pure typography, so it stays on-brand with nothing but your font. Risk: subtle weight steps vanish after compression and at thumbnail size — only use 200, ~500 and 800.

Adapt to your product: fill the grid with your own values (response times, stock levels, lead scores) and map deviation from normal to weight; use any variable font with a wide weight axis.
